title: E7 WRR-floor test is vacuous: weights {100,1,1} exceed MAX_WEIGHT=64, are silently rejected, and the zero-share premise never holds
detail: MAX_WEIGHT is 64 (qos.odin) and validate_command returns Invalid_Weights above it; submit_c swallows the error, so the pipe keeps default {1,4,1}: narrow capacity 5 allocates Standard 3 units, not 0. total_del > 0 passes with the E7 floor code deleted — the floor (priority question 2) is effectively untested.
recommended_fix: Use valid floor-triggering weights (e.g. {64,1,1} on narrow) and make submit_c tfail on validation error.

title: Queue-overflow shed (queue_drop_depth, newest-first) and the E9 drop-ladder emptiness combos have no test
evidence:
+// flow_edge_test.odin — edge-path flow contracts: E1 severance (both branches,
+// on a CONGESTED pipe so packets are actually mid-edge at demolish), QoS
+// gap-fill + WRR floor (ODN-3/§11.2), E22 pool cap, E28 asymmetry.
detail: The edge suite's declared scope omits the per-lane queue bound; no test in this diff references Queue_Overflow or queue_drop_depth (grep: 0 hits). §11.7 E9 asks for the full ladder across emptiness combos; shed order and the depth boundary are unverified.
recommended_fix: Add a flow test that overfills one lane beyond queue_drop_depth and asserts newest-first Queue_Overflow drops.

title: Node-health warning surface (Strained/Critical, Ev_Warning_Raised/Cleared) has zero coverage in tests and demos
evidence:
(worktree, demos/surge_basics.dem — the crisis coverage ceiling)
expect event forecast_issued within 55000ms..65000ms
expect event crisis_triggered surge within 119000ms..121000ms
expect event run_won within 299000ms..310000ms
detail: No test in this diff touches crisis_evaluate or Ev_Warning_* (grep: 0 hits), and the richest demo asserts only forecast/trigger/won. The 🟡/🔴 threshold transitions, tombstone reset, and cleared-on-healthy are unverified (priority question 4).
recommended_fix: Unit-test crisis_evaluate with synthetic node_load against the catalog strain/critical thresholds; add a demo expect for warning_raised.

title: Catalog fail-fast validation (ODN-5) has no failure-path test — only success-path loads
detail: Every test load goes through must_catalogs (valid shipping data) or the patched-pool-cap success case. None of the named rejections — bad logic_hz, unknown class refs, empty ids, breach_exit < win, rolling_window bounds — is asserted anywhere.
recommended_fix: Table-drive one negative test per loader rejection rule.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 100%: replay byte-identity keystone is packet-rich and guarded (pipe_count >= 5, deliveries > 0, non-empty action log), seed reproduce/diverge, ODN-11 log round-trip + corrupt rejection, NetworkHealth win/lose/drain/grace/hysteresis/flap/second-surge/terminal-barrier, surge-win + idle-404 full runs — verified green locally (40 core + 5 app tests). P1 ~85%: QoS allocate E8/E5/emphasis, promote/demote, gap-fill, E26, ports 4, upgrade delta+span, E23, E22, E28, E1, E31 covered; E7 floor vacuous, E9 ladder/overflow shed + warning surface untested; mid/high port tiers only implicitly covered. Overall ≥80%.
recommended_fix: Fix the E7 test premise, add E9/overflow and warning-surface tests to reach PASS (P1 ≥90%).
